sloka: वारणानां सहस्रं तु शरीरे ऽस्य प्रधावितम् ।कुम्भकर्णस्ततो बुद्धः स्पर्शं परमबुध्यत ।। ६.६०.५६ ।।।।
transliteration: vāraṇānāṁ sahasraṁ tu śarīre 'sya pradhāvitam ।kumbhakarṇastato buddhaḥ sparśaṁ paramabudhyata ।। 6.60.56 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, devoid of any beauty threw out his limbs which were like the coils of cobra and as hard as mountain tops, his mouth was unnatural like a submarine fire as he yawned.
